summary: Theriva Biologics filed Item 8.01 on Form 8-K disclosing that its June 5, 2026 Special Meeting of Stockholders lacked a quorum and could not be convened. The meeting was to seek approval to issue shares upon exercise of warrants under an October 2025 inducement agreement. The company plans to call a new meeting and file updated proxy materials. This is an administrative update on a failed quorum, not a special situation event. No deal terms are present.
